messages: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.

#p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p403##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I greeted #p403#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.
name: First Greeting with Shumi, the Town Resident
